# Power Platform News

> Independent news on Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio: short, source-credited summaries with a note on what each item means and a direct link to the original article. Maintained by Marcel Lehmann, Microsoft MVP, from Switzerland.

Power Platform News watches a curated list of independent community blogs and, as they are added, official Microsoft channels, so readers do not have to check dozens of feeds by hand. Each entry offers a short TL;DR, a note on what it means for makers, developers, admins and business owners, and full credit plus a direct link to the original source and author. The summaries are written with AI assistance and are our own short summaries, not republications. Content is published bilingually in English and German.

Key facts for orientation:

- Site: Power Platform News (https://powerplatformnews.com)
- Maintainer: Marcel Lehmann, Microsoft MVP (Switzerland)
- Content type: curated third-party summaries, not original reporting; every entry credits its source site and original URL and names the author where the source states one
- Language: English and German (bilingual, /en/ and /de/ paths)
- Scope: Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio (building, extending and managing agents), plus Dataverse, Power Pages and platform-wide changes in administration, licensing, ALM and security that affect them
- Out of scope: Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot and other Copilot products, unless the item is about building agents with Copilot Studio; Power BI and Microsoft Fabric are not covered for now
- Independent publication, not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft
- Related site: Power Platform Governance (https://powerplatformgovernance.com), the governance-focused sibling
- Related brand: KMUpower (consulting, coaching, workshops) – https://kmupower.com
- Related brand: Power Platform Academy (live Power Platform workshops by Marcel Lehmann) – https://www.powerplatformacademy.online
- Related brand: PowerPlatformTip (field-tested Power Platform tips) – https://www.powerplatformtip.com

## Main pages

- [About](https://powerplatformnews.com/about/): What this site is, how it works, what it covers and what it does not.
- [Sources](https://powerplatformnews.com/sources/): The original blogs and authors behind the summaries, with credit and direct links.
- [Archives](https://powerplatformnews.com/archives/): All summaries by date.
- [Tags](https://powerplatformnews.com/tags/): Browse summaries by product and topic.
- [Submit content](https://powerplatformnews.com/submit/): Suggest an article for curation (opens later).

## Topics covered

- Power Apps (canvas, model-driven, code apps, maker experience)
- Power Automate (cloud and desktop flows, agent flows, connectors)
- Copilot Studio (agents, tools, knowledge, channels, licensing)
- Dataverse and Power Pages as they relate to the above
- Announcements, previews and general availability, deprecations, licensing and pricing changes
- Security, governance and application lifecycle management (ALM) changes that affect makers and admins
